csv_scope_of_work: Hernando County is seeking a full-service architectural and design team to support the development of a central Fleet Garage Facility. The selected firm will provide program verification and assessment, site evaluation and recommendations, and the preparation of conceptual, schematic, design development, construction administration, and bidding documents, along with cost estimates. The project may involve either the development of a new Fleet Garage Facility on a new site or the renovation, expansion, and/or redesign of an existing facility. The final project approach will be determined based on a comprehensive evaluation of potential sites and the feasibility of improving the County s existing fleet operations facility.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering
